<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1809800_event_0.KAPGetLastBookingDaysAgo</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>KAPGetLastBookingDaysAgo</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var KAPGetLastBookingDaysAgo = Class.create();
KAPGetLastBookingDaysAgo.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {
  
  getDaysSinceLastBooking: function() {
    var userId = gs.getUserID();
    var gr = new GlideRecord("x_1809800_event_0_event_booking"); 

    gr.addQuery('booked_by', userId);
    gr.orderByDesc('start_date');  // Sort by latest
    gr.setLimit(1);
    gr.query();

    if (gr.next()) {
      var last = new GlideDateTime(gr.getValue('start_date'));
      var now = new GlideDateTime();
      var diffMillis = GlideDateTime.subtract(now, last).getNumericValue();
      var days = Math.floor(diffMillis / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
      return days + '';
    }

    return '-1'; // No bookings found
  }

});
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-08-05 16:09:50</sys_created_on><sys_id>26e608bbc34f6210eae2e04bb00131f7</sys_id><sys_mod_count>8</sys_mod_count><sys_name>KAPGetLastBookingDaysAgo</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Event Space Booking " source="x_1809800_event_0">9853c2ebc3836210eae2e04bb001318e</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Event Space Booking ">9853c2ebc3836210eae2e04bb001318e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_26e608bbc34f6210eae2e04bb00131f7</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-08-05 17:15:24</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
